node.statement: By lem-prh-sharpness-family-arithmetic, M_lambda A_lambda has rows (1-lambda^2,lambda^2) and (lambda^2,1-lambda^2); using its induced l-infinity norm formula gives epsilon_lambda=||M_lambda A_lambda-I_2||_{infinity->infinity}=2*lambda^2, and this tends to 0 as lambda tends to 0.
